Project VoCo looks amazing. Realistic speech synthesis is kind of terrifying (a lot more so than people think the DeepFake thing, if you ask me) but it's pretty fascinating. Although VoCo isn't so good that it can mimic a voice with a few seconds speech. In the demonstration they only showed one or two source sentences but really the software needs more like 20+ minutes of high-quality speech (not that that would be hard to find for anyone even remotely in the public eye).

The stinger is that Adobe don't seem to have any plans to release VoCo (at least not any time soon). It was just a technology that a small team were working on and they wanted to show off. Last I heard there was a lot of work to be done making it more secure, so that it couldn't be used nefariously (let's face it, sooner or later it will get used by assholes to do really assholey things). It's a big can of worms that I don't think Adobe want to open until they've got their asses very thoroughly covered.

There are a few neural network speech synthesis scripts floating around on GitHub that give mixed results. Lyrebird is the easiest to play with and looks quite promising. It seems to get decent results from 1 minute of source audio, but it has to be certain phrases probably more of a security thing than an actual requirement for it to work). But as far as fake porn goes, right now you're better off with a real voice that doesn't match the face than a strange, uncanny valley voice that's been pooped out by a neural network.

If someone did want to go the extra mile and replace a mismatched voice, they would be better off just finding a scene with an actor/actress who has a similar voice to the person you're faking and dubbing that audio over the faked video. Long phrases would be very challenging to pull off, but luckily 99% of porn is random moaning, panting, screaming, grunting, etc and short, commonly used phrases ("fuck me harder!", "yeah! that's the spot!", etc), and that type of stuff should be pretty simple (albeit time consuming) to swap out. If the person you're faking has sex-scenes in their movies that you could use audio from, even better.

TLDR - The Adobe thing looks cool AF but we aint getting any time soon.
